decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed roof extension with a volume of 37.7 cubic metres, which combines with the existing rear and side ground floor extensions (volume 11.3 cubic metres) to create a total volume increase of 49 cubic metres and includes:
?	A roof addition over the main rear roof with a width of 4.6m, height of 2.8m and depth of 3.2m, with a volume of 20.6 cubic metres; and
?	A roof addition over part of the two-storey rear projection roof with a width of 3.1m, height of 1.3 to 2.4m and depth - 2.9m, with a volume of 17.1 cubic metres,
as shown on drawing number 3030 dated 8 February 2002 and received by Council on 18 February 2003, is lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and therefore does not require planning permission.
Certificate of Lawfulness be GRANTED.
Condition : 2 - 1.	The proposed domed roof lights shall not protrude above the original ridgeline of the roof of the dwellinghouse.

Reason: To ensure the development at the property is in accordance with the criteria for permitted development
Condition : 3 - 2.	The roof extension currently constructed on site shall be modified to accord with drawing number 3030 dated 8 February 2002 and received by Council on 18 February 2003.

Reason: To ensure the development at the property is in accordance with the criteria for permitted development.
description: Certifcate of Lawfulness for the erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse.
